Man arrested for rape after online friendship turns violent

A man has been arrested for allegedly raping a woman he met through Instagram. The incident reportedly occurred after the woman was taken to a room and tied up. The arrest was facilitated with the help of a delivery boy. One report mentions the accused had taken the woman to a Jagannathji fair and sought vows of marriage, and that the woman became pregnant.
